approved_scope: Ordinary conservative chip-firing HALTING is NP-complete for finite loopless simple strongly connected digraphs on at least two vertices, including a separate oriented subclass. Hardness retains a supplied root whose deletion is acyclic with no directed two-arc path and polynomial numerical total initial chips, hence unary-chip hardness. NP membership covers arbitrary binary nonnegative configurations. No dissipative sinks, weighted thresholds, fixed graph, bounded degree, polynomial simulation time, or priority claim.
